operator: 11/18: 'Yes, confirm it' - the MARKET_DROP skip (docs/studies/entry_context_skip_prereg.json) was right in both halves on broker trades but FAILED significance (t 1.1, 14 test days)
rule: skip a buy signal if SPY's return over the 5 complete minutes before the entry minute is <= -5 bp (X = 5 fixed from the broker-trade train half; no re-selection here)

data.signals: the desk's live pre-square arm on SIP minute bars (news_source.signals_for: fast %R 21, refractory 30, minutes 15-360), top-400 liquid universe, $20-$400, up >= 1.5% at the signal minute (the BASE arm of relative_admit / news_source), every warehouse day with SPY
data.spy: SPY minute closes from the same day file (sip_hedge merged)
data.trade: buy open t+1, sell close t+10, flat 6 bp (as news_source); information: straight-down = low over t+1..t+10 <= open(t+1) - 40 bp

pass_if_ALL.book: mean delta per signal (skipped -> 0 instead of net) >= +1.0 bp
pass_if_ALL.both_halves: book delta > 0 in the first and the second half of the days
pass_if_ALL.kept_quality: kept signals' mean net > all signals' mean net

after_pass: build the skip behind a switch (default off) reading SPY minute closes from the live tape (market_tape); under the operator's 11/18 rule a PASS ships (paper) - the next session's experiment
caveats: minute bars with a fixed 10-minute exit, not the desk's trail; the broker-trade result that motivated it is NOT re-used here
